publishedDeadlines.label: Spring application
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated; confirm the intended admission cycle.

applicationFee.note: International processing $30; domestic $20. Central page offers possible waiver/discount and directs applicants to Graduate School; no citizenship limitation stated. Confirm international eligibility and approval before paying.

english.note: PTE 58 also accepted. Department accepts successful completion of campus IELP. Central waiver examples: accredited US bachelor’s/master’s or origin in listed countries. No general foreign English-medium exemption verified.

documents: Transcripts; foreign records require NACES member evaluation including GPA and US degree equivalency
Statement of purpose describing research interests, experience and goals
requirements.note: Accredited bachelor’s, GPA 3.0 and satisfactory standing at previous institution. Prior research desired. GRE program-specific requirement not established; central says most programs no longer require it, which does not alone prove a Biology policy. Late applications depend on positions/funding.

funding.note: Department endeavors to support accepted students through teaching/research assistantships, scholarships or fellowships; no guarantee or current stipend verified. Board of Regents doctoral fellowship described separately is US-citizen-only and requires GPA 3.5 and GRE verbal/quantitative above 70 thpercentile.
